title: רב נחמן בר אדא

paragraphs: Rav Naḥman bar Adda said: Shemuel said, Eruvin 34b; son of Rav Adda said: Shemuel said, there 80a. R. Yonah says: Naḥman bar Adda taught; R. Yosa says: Naḥman the elder taught, Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Megillah 2; Berakhot 2, mishnah 4. Eruvin 102a: Naḥumi bar Adda. Beitzah 31b: Naḥumi bar Adda said: Shemuel said. Yuḥasin also includes him thus; all are one.
